name: Tall grama grass
desc: Tall grama grass (Bouteloua curtipendula): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 52 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Bouteloua curtipendula, commonly known as sideoats grama, is a perennial, short prairie grass that is native throughout the temperate and tropical Western Hemisphere, from Canada south to Argentina.
